{{Quote|Glorzo proposed a contest. The scavenger and I would head into the Vaal asteroid field&mdash;hopefully surviving more than two minutes. The first to bring back a stone from the Rukabi Major asteroid would win dear Holiday.|[[Tharan Cedrax]]|<ref name="The Old Republic" />}}
'''Rukabi Major''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located within the [[Vaal asteroid field]]. Around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Glorzo]] issued a contest there where the winner would acquire a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] program named [[Holiday (hologram)|Holiday]].
